claims.text: check-deps attempts to build non-existent targets such as bitcoin_kernel
claims.quote: It also doesn't seem good to try to build targets that don't exist, like this currently does with `bitcoin_kernel`.

claims.text: moving init/common.cpp from libbitcoin_common to libbitcoin_node prevents auxiliary binaries like bitcoin-wallet and bitcoin-mine from using logging
claims.quote: I don't think it's good to remove `init/common.cpp` from libbitcoin_common and move it to libbitcoin_node, because this prevents binaries other than `bitcoind` from being able to call `StartLogging`
